category_title: Elementary students with mild mental retardation and language delay who struggle with complex reasoning and auditory triggers
scenario_title: Auditory Triggers and Cognitive Overload during Navigation
minimal_context: The student is answering a set of 10 to 12 question-based learning items in a virtual context.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You have finished six questions. Let's keep going and answer the next four questions in the virtual world.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks away from the computer screen and points toward the window to watch the kids walking outside the classroom)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please look back at the screen. Click your answer and listen to the audio explanation.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stares blankly as the long aural and textual feedback plays, completely losing attention on the learning task)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Now we need to move to the next area. Click the teleport button on the screen.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Hears the sound of the teleport and suddenly shrinks back, looking frightened and refusing to touch the mouse)
